text:
maria: Heads-up — I’m seeing a persistent unit-cost delta on /chat/generate (prod) since the kernel-selector change last Thursday. Per-token cost up ~12% for that route, latency P50 unchanged but token-latency tail increased. Can we add/confirm token-level instrumentation to trace kernel_choice, kv_hit, and route_id? Need to rule out batching heuristic or KV cache regression.

kevin: Thanks, Maria. I pulled a short sample from canary: kernel-selector occasionally picks the 'long-seq' kernel for very short responses (1-6 tokens). Suspect heuristic misfire when prompt length ~512 and completion tiny. Quick promql I ran: 
```
rate(inference_calls_total{route="/chat/generate",env="prod",kernel="long-seq"}[5m]) / rate(inference_calls_total{route="/chat/generate",env="prod"}[5m])
```
shows a 7% bump in long-seq share during the window. Attaching a tiny trace snippet: 
```
trace: route=/chat/generate id=abc123 kernel=long-seq seq_in=512 seq_out=3 kv_hit=false batch_size=1 token_latency_ms=[3,12,9]
```

samir: Agree we need more granular metrics. Proposal: emit per-token histogram `token_latency_seconds` with labels {route, kernel_choice, kv_hit, batch_size_bucket} AND a counter `billed_tokens_total{route,customer_tier}` that mirrors billing pipeline. Also add `kernel_selection_reason` tag (e.g., pinned, heuristic, fallback). This lets us slice econ by kernel and kv_hit. I can spike the histogram in the runtime and a small shim to tag tokens with kernel_choice.

elaine: We also need dashboard & alerting changes for billing alignment. Suggested alerts: 1) route per-token-cost delta > 8% over baseline for 3h, 2) kv_hit_rate(route) drops < 70% for 30m, 3) kernel_choice_share(long-seq) > 5% sustained for 1h on high-traffic routes. Will add a panel that shows `token_cost_cents / billed_tokens` by route + a small table mapping kernel -> avg token cost.

kevin: I'll open a PR that adds `route_id` and `kernel_choice` to the token tracer and increments `billed_tokens_total` in the billing path. Also will add a sampling flag so we don't explode metrics cardinality (default sample_rate=0.01 for low tier).

maria: +1 on sampling. Important: billing pipeline needs an authoritative mapping; if runtime tags differ from billing tags we'll get reconciliation noise. Elaine — can your team run a one-off billing-recon job comparing `billed_tokens_total` vs raw invoices for last 7 days after we land the runtime tags?

elaine: Yep, will run recon. For immediate triage we should also surface a small per-route CSV export from dashboard (route, kernel_choice_share, kv_hit_rate, avg_token_cost) so finance can see line items.

atlas-bot: deploy: kernel-selector v2 promoted to canary in us-west-2 by ci/auto-deploy (build 2026.03.17-2140).

kevin: Noted. Canary traffic matches where the delta was seen. I'll keep an eye and add additional logs for kernel_selection_reason.

samir: One more callout: KV cache rehydration storms after evictions can look like kv_hit=false spikes and drive token cost up due to smaller batches. Suggest we emit `kv_eviction_rate` and a small gauge `recent_kv_warm_fraction` per node. That will help correlate rehydration events with cost spikes.

maria: Action items: kevin — tracing + metrics PR (ETA EOD), samir — runtime histogram + kv gauges (ETA tomorrow), elaine — billing recon + dashboard export (ETA EOD tomorrow). I'll create a short postmortem if cost delta persists after these changes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
